metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for fullstack AI application development: staged workflow with gates, ADRs, doc-aware review and PR automation, LLM app patterns, API contract sync, and design fidelity.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Architectural Decision Records: capture decisions from a brainstorming session or reconstruct them from an existing codebase. Includes a hook that checks existing ADRs after design discussions.

plugins.name: frontend-toolkit
plugins.description: Frontend work without Tailwind: distinctive interface design using custom CSS, Storybook component documentation, and AG-UI protocol expertise.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Delegate large-context, multimodal, and bulk-refactoring work to Gemini CLI, with token savings reported.

plugins.name: review-mr
plugins.description: The /mr command: audit a branch against project docs and ADRs, fix findings, commit without AI attribution, and open a GitHub PR from the repository template.

plugins.name: workflow-gates
plugins.description: Staged delivery workflow with hard gates: explore, PRD, spec, plan, tasks, implement, feedback, review, finalize. Enforces ADR-per-decision and living specs.

plugins.name: llm-app-patterns
plugins.description: Patterns for AI-powered apps: retrieval evaluation, grounded generation with citations, SSE streaming UI, and the OpenAI API.

plugins.name: api-contract-sync
plugins.description: Keep a typed backend API and its frontend client in sync via OpenAPI codegen, with drift detection in CI.

plugins.name: design-fidelity
plugins.description: Verify an implemented UI against its design spec: token compliance, responsive breakpoints, and interaction states.

plugins.name: claude-docs
plugins.description: Write and audit agent-facing documentation on a progressive-disclosure model: a short CLAUDE.md of critical rules that routes to detail loaded only when needed.

plugins.name: skill-porting
plugins.description: Convert agent skills between Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini formats.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Write and audit project documentation on the Diataxis model without tutorials: explanation, reference, and optional how-to, one topic per folder.
